_comment: QC station qc_01 = the conveyor agent (Arduino Opta + Hikrobot SC3000, github.com/raghulrajg/conveyor_agent). The Opta publishes one verdict per part on autonomous/product/Transformation; this agent turns the first verdict after the robot loaded the part into the QC result. Run it on the central server: python3 launch.py agents agents/qc_01_conveyor.json (systemd: robot-fleet-agent@qc_01_conveyor). Run only ONE qc_01_* agent at a time (this one, qc_01_scanner.json or qc_01_stand_in.json). The Opta sketch's MQTT_BROKER_IP / MQTT_TOPIC must match .env and result_topic. exit_travel_s: the Opta publishes the verdict while the part is still at the camera (S2); the verdict is reported this many seconds later so the unload pick finds the part at the exit S3 -- set it to the measured S2->S3 travel time plus a margin (timeout_s + exit_travel_s must stay below site.json quality_check, 90).
